scope: 16 reviewed warm arms plus 4 controls; read-only public process audit, no rescoring. Post-outcome stratification, not blinded, prevalence estimate, paired performance estimate, or replacement for full96 census.
warmRule: From complete reviewed Atlas/Hermes pairs: one pair per each of eight families, four pairs per condition, at least one finding and one no-finding arm in each harness/condition cell. Minimize distance of total finding arms from 8, then maximize distinct existing finding kinds for diagnostic coverage, then lowest SHA256 of atlas-c5-peer-v1 plus sorted exact IDs. All criteria use metadata only.
controlRule: One complete explicit-memory cold pair and one complete native-default identity pair; require one finding and one no-finding arm per harness, then lowest SHA256 of atlas-c5-control-peer-v1 plus sorted IDs. Report separately.
